title: Risk-Off Capital Cycle
description: Institutional money rotates out of high-growth bets and into safer assets. Customers spend slower and investors ask harder questions.

title: Rate Hike Shock
description: Capital gets expensive quickly. Venture checks get smaller and operating budgets tighten across the market.

title: Supply Chain Bottleneck
description: Infrastructure vendors and service providers pass through delays and surcharges. Launches still happen, just with more friction.

title: Cloud Pricing Reset
description: Major providers quietly remove aggressive credits and promo tiers. Infra-heavy products feel it first.

title: Privacy Regulation Wave
description: New compliance requirements hit growth channels, but trust in serious operators improves over time.

title: Ad Market Correction
description: Performance marketing weakens and ad inventory reprices. Monetized products see softer top-line numbers.

title: Creator Platform Boom
description: Short-form content and creator tools surge again. Products with social loops ride a meaningful tailwind.

title: Remote Work Reacceleration
description: Distributed teams increase spend on workflow, compliance, and developer tooling. B2B adoption speeds up.

title: Open-Source Breakthrough Cycle
description: Core infra primitives get cheaper and better. Teams ship faster with less spend on foundational work.

title: AI Productivity Wave
description: AI copilots and automation tooling become mainstream. Shipping velocity rises, and expectations rise with it.

title: Capital Reopens
description: Risk appetite comes back and growth stories get funded faster. Deals close with less friction than last year.

title: Compliance Spending Cycle
description: Enterprise buyers increase budgets for auditability and risk controls. Strong operators gain pricing power.

title: Founder Docuseries Cycle
description: A flashy startup mini-series dominates the feed. Users romanticize builder culture, and sign-up intent spikes for product-led teams.

title: Boardroom Memo Leak Cycle
description: A parade of leaked strategy decks puts startup culture under a microscope. Churn pressure ticks up as users scrutinize trust.

title: Global Tariff Shock
description: A wave of new trade restrictions hits hardware and cloud supply chains. Infrastructure costs tick up across the board as providers pass costs downstream.

title: Data Privacy Regulation Wave
description: Sweeping new data privacy laws pass in multiple regions. Consumer-facing apps face compliance overhead; B2B SaaS companies with enterprise clients see procurement cycles lengthen.

title: Geopolitical Instability Period
description: Rising tensions between major economies create uncertainty across global markets. Investor appetite shifts toward defensive assets; growth-stage funding slows noticeably.

title: Antitrust Scrutiny Wave
description: Regulators worldwide launch investigations into platform monopolies. Big Tech spends heavily on lobbying. Startups in adjacent spaces benefit from the spotlight on alternatives.

title: Global Recession Signals
description: Leading economic indicators flash warning signs. Consumer spending tightens, enterprise budgets freeze, and CFOs everywhere issue variance reports. Survival mode activates across the industry.

title: Currency Volatility Cycle
description: Fluctuating exchange rates ripple through international revenue. Companies with global user bases see unpredictable revenue swings quarter-to-quarter as currency markets stay choppy.

title: AI Regulation Uncertainty
description: Governments debate landmark AI legislation with no clear outcome in sight. AI-adjacent products face compliance ambiguity; some enterprise buyers pause AI procurement until the dust settles.

title: Supply Chain Normalization
description: Global logistics bottlenecks ease after a prolonged disruption cycle. Cloud infrastructure costs begin stabilizing, and hardware-dependent startups see margin relief.

title: Interest Rate Cut Cycle
description: Central banks signal a rate-cutting cycle. Risk appetite returns to institutional investors, and growth-stage valuations begin recovering from the compression of the past year.

title: Big Tech Layoff Wave
description: Major technology companies announce sweeping headcount reductions. The talent market floods with senior engineers and experienced PMs. Your hiring pipeline gets significantly stronger.

title: Platform Policy Crackdown
description: A major app distribution platform tightens its developer policies. App review times double, new submission requirements add compliance overhead, and some monetization hooks get flagged.
